ref: ADR-0005: power with a fractional exponent is computed in xs:double (the catalogue deviation)
note: An integer base against a fractional exponent, and a negative integer exponent, which is not an exact power: 9^0.5, 2^0.5, 4^-0.5, 2^-2, 10^-2, 2^3.5. Each is Math.pow of the two doubles, written as the xs:decimal it equals exactly (10^-2 is 0.01000000000000000020816681711721685132943093776702880859375).
